scope: Two real native Minecraft clients; independent offline UUIDs; host local native channel, peer genuine TCP. Four mods, not full pack; QA supplied gear/environment, not survival acquisition.

never_write_or_replace: school/slot/secret owners already responsible for their own containers
guardrails.root_policy: only source-audited named permanent root fields and historical quest keys, with correct tag types and detached Tag.copy; do not copy whole getPersistentData()
guardrails.do_not_generalize: a timer can intentionally survive death inside its existing owner. Preserve saved deadlines through existing handlers; this does not justify copying transient root immunity/counterattack/charge/cooldown grants.
guardrails.regression_expectation: after minimal root fix, all existing saved deadline/generation values and before-original-deadline no-proc remain unchanged; new handler must never reset or rebase these deadlines

limits: Fresh QA native world with stable ce9259, not imported historical player save. No production fix applied. No whole boss fight; no promise all permanent root keys persist.
Receipt proves these four saved keys across observed events, not all armor/whole pack/permanent roots.
No independent native rerun performed by migration researcher. Local QA/source review gives zero toward external1000.
